description: P1-08-SEC-003 — Appointment (apt) + Vehicle Reception (rec) personal-data / sensitivity classification registry. Every live apt/rec column is classified. Restricted columns (complaint narrative, vehicle-content description + declared value) are row-gated by iam.sensitive.view and must never be searchable. Reconciled against the live schema by scripts/check-aptrec-classification.mjs (run identically locally and in CI).
